Terms & disclaimer

Research and information only

EdgeDesk aggregates public betting odds and applies statistical methods (vig removal, fair-line estimation, EV comparison) to surface informational signals. It is not a sportsbook, does not place wagers, and does not provide betting, financial, or investment advice, nor any guarantee or prediction of outcome.

No reliance, no warranty

Data and signals are provided "as is," may be delayed, inaccurate, or incomplete, and are frequently wrong. You are solely responsible for verifying anything before acting on it.

Your responsibility

You alone are responsible for your betting decisions and any losses. You must confirm betting is legal where you are and that you meet the minimum legal age (21+ in most US jurisdictions).

Responsible gambling

Only bet what you can afford to lose. Problem gambling: call 1-800-GAMBLER or visit ncpgambling.org.

Research tool only — not betting advice. Signals can be wrong. 21+. 1-800-GAMBLER.
